thread:
Jon Park: quick check — PowellBank POC dry run still on for Mon 8am PT? Need final list of owners and blockers.
Maria Chen: yes, still on. Final milestone: demo dataset + SSO test + perf smoke. I'm owning datasets. ETA: EOD Fri for sample push.
Lee Huang: @Maria can you confirm schema shape? we need tokenization parity with staging.
Maria Chen: will confirm. current dataset is small (5k queries). I'll add 2 more user flows.
Sarah Patel: I'm owning SSO + success criteria doc. Can we confirm SLOs? 95th p95 < 200ms for embeddings call? that's tight.
Lee Huang: embeddings path on dedicated GPUs should hit sub-150ms for 128-dim. But under load might be 220ms. We should set demo SLO to p95<250ms.
Jon Park: OK p95<250ms demo SLO sounds good. Who's doing network / firewall rules for customer IPs?
DevOps Bot: deploy scheduled: powellbank-staging -> canary at 2024-07-15T15:00Z
Lee Huang: @Jon I'll own firewall with infra. Need customer IP list + CIDRs from SE.
Jon Park: forwarding now — sending in separate DM. @Lee also need model pinning to r-infer/powerbank-1.2.
Lee Huang: noted. I'll pin in deploy.yaml and push PR. pinging @Maria for test dataset commit so I can run smoke.
Maria Chen: pushed dataset branch: feature/powell-data. PR: https://git.internal/r/data/powellbank/pull/42
Lee Huang: thanks — running local smoke now.
Sarah Patel: FYI success criteria: 1) correctness pass on 20 eval prompts, 2) SSO login success for 2 users, 3) end-to-end latency p95<250ms, 4) no token leakage. I'll add to shared doc.
Jon Park: can someone take a quick CR on @Lee's PR? small change to deploy config. Need it merged before canary.
Maria Chen: I'll review in 30m.
Lee Huang: adding small config snippet here:
```
deploy:
  model: r-infer/powerbank-1.2
  env: powellbank-staging
  pin: true
  batch_size: 8
```
Jon Park: also need feature flags toggled: 'powellbank-demo' = on in console.
DevOps Bot: feature flag update request queued. Ticket #5678.
Sarah Patel: I'll coordinate the customer dry run script and send to their ops team tonight.
Jon Park: blockers? anything that will push us past Mon window?
Maria Chen: only if SSO certs aren't issued by Friday. I asked SE to confirm with Powell.
Lee Huang: infra will be ready as long as CIDRs + certs come through.
Sarah Patel: I'll chase certs. @Jon want me to escalate to your AE if no reply by noon?
Jon Park: yes please. escalate at noon. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
DevOps Bot: reminder: dry-run checklist assigned to sales-powell channel. https://links.internal/checklists/powell-dryrun
Maria Chen: noted, will update checklist when dataset PR merges. :white_check_mark:
